subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'feeds'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• From the given options it is clear that the given blank will have a form of the **verb feed**.
 
• For the **pronoun it **we use the **third person present tense.**
 
 
• **Feed **is the root verb form.
 
• **is feeding **is the **gerund form.**
 
• **Feeds **is the** third person present tense form.**
 
• **Fed **is the** past tense form of feed. **
 
 
 
• So, the **third person present tense **form of **feed i.e., feeds **is appropriate for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer. 

***Correct passage - **Oxygen fuels our living processes. It contracts our muscles, helps our cells to work, grow and regenerate, (1)** feeds **our brains, calms our nerves, helps the heart to pump, fights infection and (2)** boosts **immunity," says Dr Narendra Nath Jena, Director, Institute of Emergency Medicine, MMH R Centre, Madurai. Once air enters the nose or mouth, it gets humidified and reaches (3)** the **alveoli. The alveoli are tiny air sacs that help to (4)** pull in **oxygen and transfer it into the blood stream and also to pull out the carbon dioxide and push it out of the lungs. COVID-19 destroys (5)** these **alveoli by thickening the walls so gas exchange becomes difficult.*
